Hi Alan / procurement team —

Following up on Alan’s request: I uploaded a one‑pager that summarizes the data flow and retention controls here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/medanova-demo-20270321 (file: medanova-dataflow-onepager.pdf). Quick highlights for legal/engineering:

- Data flows: customer payloads are accepted via our VPC endpoint and never persisted in plaintext outside of the customer VPC unless explicitly configured for logging/observability.
- KV cache: per‑request KV cache is ephemeral and isolated per customer; cache is invalidated on model version changes.
- Retention: default token logs retained for 30 days for debugging; longer retention options available under dedicated/private plans.
- Audit: request level logs with request ids and timestamps; full export available for SOC2 audits.

If you could indicate priority by replying with one of: High / Medium / Low, that will help us decide whether to reserve dev time for a short POC.

Available 10‑minute windows I still have:
- Tue 29 Mar, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Tue 29 Mar, 10:15–10:45 PT
(If neither works I can open other slots.)

If procurement wants a separate thread for legal, happy to loop in our security lead.

Thanks — a one‑line reply works here (e.g., "High — schedule 10 min on Tue 29 10:15 PT").

Best,
